data.one_liner: A powerful API query builder for constructing structured queries with filtering, ordering, and pagination.
data.what_it_does: It provides a type-safe, fluent interface for building complex API queries with filtering, sorting, pagination, and field selection. It includes converters to serialize queries into standard API formats like REST, GraphQL, or OData.
use_when: You need to build complex, structured API queries programmatically with nested AND/OR logic.
You want to decouple query construction from the underlying transport or API format.
avoid_when: Your application only executes raw SQL queries or hardcoded API endpoints without dynamic filtering needs.
strengths: Type-safe fluent interface for query building
Support for nested filter groups with unlimited nesting
Extensible converters for custom API formats
weaknesses: Requires learning a specific query construction model
